description: Land Acquisition - Pepiliyana, Kesbewa D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, detailing specific parcels of land being acquired by the government for a public purpose. It contains descriptions of land lots, assessment numbers, extents, and claimants, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land acquisitions and property matters.
